mapper.insert: INSERT INTO task (id, user_id, template_id, template_title, template_cover_path, canvas_width, canvas_height, client_request_id, status, current_stage, max_step_attempts, retry_count, resume_count, failure_simulated) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{templateId}, #{templateTitle}, #{templateCoverPath}, #{canvasWidth}, #{canvasHeight}, #{clientRequestId}, 'QUEUED', NULL, #{maxStepAttempts}, 0, 0, 0)

mapper.select:
SELECT t.id, t.template_id, COALESCE(tt.title, tm.title, t.template_title) AS display_title, t.template_cover_path, t.status, t.current_stage, t.failure_code, t.failure_args, t.failure_simulated, t.retry_count, t.max_step_attempts, t.resume_count, t.next_retry_at, t.last_error_code, t.last_error_simulated, t.result_width, t.result_height, t.created_at, t.updated_at, t.finished_at, COALESCE(( SELECT s.attempt_count FROM task_step s WHERE s.task_id = t.id AND s.status IN ('RUNNING','FAILED','SUCCEEDED') ORDER BY s.seq DESC LIMIT 1 ), 0) AS current_attempt_count FROM task t LEFT JOIN template tm ON tm.id = t.template_id LEFT JOIN template_translation tt ON tt.template_id = t.template_id AND tt.locale = #{locale}
ORDER BY t.created_at DESC, t.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT id FROM task WHERE status = 'QUEUED' OR (status = 'RETRYING' AND next_retry_at <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)) ORDER BY created_at, id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE task SET status = 'RUNNING', current_stage = #{stage}, next_retry_at = NULL, last_error_code = NULL, last_error_detail = NULL, last_error_simulated = NULL, started_at = COALESCE(started_at, UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)), row_version = row_version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('QUEUED','RETRYING') AND (status = 'QUEUED' OR next_retry_at <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(3))
UPDATE task SET current_stage = #{stage}, row_version = row_version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RUNNING'

UPDATE task SET status = 'SUCCEEDED', current_stage = 'FINALIZE', result_storage_key = #{storageKey}, result_width = #{width}, result_height = #{height}, result_size_bytes = #{sizeBytes}, failure_code = NULL, failure_args = NULL, failure_detail = NULL, failure_simulated = 0, next_retry_at = NULL, last_error_code = NULL, last_error_detail = NULL, last_error_simulated = NULL, finished_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), row_version = row_version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RUNNING'

UPDATE task SET status = 'FAILED', failure_code = #{failureCode}, failure_args = #{failureArgs}, failure_detail = #{failureDetail}, failure_simulated = #{failureSimulated}, next_retry_at = NULL, last_error_code = NULL, last_error_detail = NULL, last_error_simulated = NULL, finished_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), row_version = row_version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RUNNING'
